SELECT T1.date_arrived ,  T1.date_departed FROM dogs AS T1 JOIN treatments AS T2 ON T1.dog_id  =  T2.dog_id
SELECT T1.first_name ,  T1.last_name FROM owners AS T1 JOIN dogs AS T2 ON T1.owner_id  =  T2.owner_id ORDER BY T2.date_of_birth LIMIT 1
SELECT email_address FROM owners WHERE state  =  "Hawaii" OR state  =  "Wisconsin"
SELECT T1.first_name ,  T1.last_name ,  T1.street ,  T1.city ,  T1.state FROM owners AS T1 JOIN professionals AS T2 ON T1.owner_id  =  T2.professional_id WHERE T2.city LIKE '%West%'
SELECT count(*) FROM owners WHERE owner_id NOT IN ( SELECT dog_id FROM dogs )
SELECT T1.name ,  T2.age ,  T2.weight FROM owners AS T1 JOIN dogs AS T2 ON T1.owner_id  =  T2.owner_id WHERE T2.abandoned_yn  =  1
SELECT charge_amount FROM charges GROUP BY charge_type ORDER BY sum(charge_amount) DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT email_address ,  cell_number ,  home_phone FROM Professionals
